title: Thutmose IV's Dream Stela

tellings.quote: during his reign, he erected something called the dream stella. And it was him talking about how when he was a young kid before he became Pharaoh, he went and slept under um the shade of the Sphinx and the Sphinx visited him in a dream

plain: A researcher named Luke Caverns tells podcast host Jesse Michels about Thutmose IV, a pharaoh, or king, of ancient Egypt. He says that while ruling, Thutmose put up a carved stone tablet now called the Dream Stela, between the paws of the Sphinx, the giant lion statue with a human head at Giza. According to Caverns, the tablet tells how Thutmose, as a boy before he became king, fell asleep in the Sphinx's shade and the Sphinx came to him in a dream.
